title: War Balance: where each country's money moved since 2022, toward Ukraine or toward Russia
description: For every country, its support for Ukraine and how much less, or more, Russia kept from trade with it (taxes and profit above a normal return, not the full price), plus Russian money frozen there, against a world without the war, from February 2022 to the latest data month, as totals against one year's GDP. Every number has a likely range, a certainty letter, a method band and its sources. Interactive map and pages: https://warbalance.org/. Data CC BY 4.0, code MIT.
